ammonia.reason: Limited amino-acid deamination at 90 days and pH 5.3; no ammonia accumulation reported.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-Cresol/indole not detected; mild barnyard from sheep-milk FFAs and Lactiplantibacillus/Leuconostoc metabolism.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin proteolysis, partly masked by high salt-in-moisture ~8.4%.

blue_moldy.reason: Low 2-heptanone 0.12 ppm and 2-nonanone 0.05 ppm from fatty-acid beta-oxidation without Penicillium.

browning.reason: Maillard of residual galactose with lysine plus low moisture/high protein gives deep browning for saganaki frying.

buttery.reason: Low diacetyl 0.039 ppm from citrate metabolism by Strep. thermophilus/Lactococcus limited by cooking and aging.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Most abundant VOC butyric acid 0.92-1.55 ppm from sheep-milk triglyceride lipolysis by native lipase/rennet.

creaminess.reason: Fat 31.1% FDM ~49-53% but low moisture and firm protein network limit creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Low moisture, pH 5.3 demineralized paracasein and granular cooked curd fracture easily.

firmness.reason: Moisture 36.8% below 38% hard-cheese limit, cooked/pressed curd and 3-month drying give hard grating body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol not detected; minimal phenylalanine catabolism in 3-month rennet cheese.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butyrate 0.11-0.17 ppm, ethyl hexanoate 0.07 ppm and methyl butyrate 0.4-0.76 ppm from LAB esterase esterification.

goaty.reason: Caproic 0.15-0.21 ppm plus C4-C6 FFAs from sheep-milk fat lipolysis give sharp sheep/goaty note.

malty_nutty.reason: Leucine catabolism to 3-methylbutanal 0.006 ppm and 3-methylbutanoic 0.168 ppm plus Strecker aldehydes in 90-day ripening.

melt.reason: Rennet-cooked, pH 5.3, 3.1% salt and low moisture restrict casein flow; softens more than flows.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one not detected; no mold surface flora.

oil_off.reason: Free oil from 31% fat coalescence on heating; lipolysis releases liquid short-chain FFAs.

sour_vinegar.reason: pH 5.3 with lactic ~19-24 mg/g and acetic 1-5 mg/g from thermophilic starter fermentation.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet gel without hot-water stretching; no aligned micelle fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Only trace dimethyl disulfide 0.004 ppm; thermization and cooked curd give mild cooked-milk sulfides.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted by starter; trace sweetness from propionic 2.6-4.8 mg/g and dairy fat.

umami.reason: 90-day proteolysis releases glutamate from 24.8% protein; enhanced by 3.1% salt.
